BC_description: The partial application feature of the applyEach and applyEachSeries functions has been removed. Previously, applyEach and applyEachSeries could be called with an array of functions and then partially applied with arguments before providing a callback, but now they require all arguments (including the callback) to be passed at once. This breaks code that relied on the old partial application behavior.
Adaptation_method: Replace partial application with explicit function calls. For example, in the old version: async.applyEach([fn1, fn2])(arg, callback) should be changed to async.applyEach([fn1, fn2], arg, callback) in the new version. Similarly, for applyEachSeries: use async.applyEachSeries([fn1, fn2], arg, callback) instead of async.applyEachSeries([fn1, fn2])(arg, callback).
